eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on Intelligence, Communication, Computing and Sustainable Technologies (IC2ST-27) aims to provide a premier interdisciplinary platform for researchers, academicians, industry professionals, and students to present and discuss innovations in intelligent systems, advanced communication technologies, computing paradigms, and sustainable engineering solutions. The conference focuses on the integration of Artificial Intelligence, next-generation communication networks, computational intelligence, and green technologies to address real-world challenges aligned with sustainable development goals. IC2ST-27 seeks high-quality original research contributions that demonstrate theoretical advancements, practical implementations, and innovative applications contributing to technological sustainability.
